stem: While resolving a claim, a community pharmacy prepares to close. Select all patient-notice duties supported by 247 CMR 6.13.

choices.text: Under these facts, identify patients who received prescriptions in the preceding 90 days.
Given the described event, destroy every patient file on the closure date.
In this setting, attempt notice at least 14 days before closure and post conspicuous notice.
Requested patient-file transfers is required to be handled timely so therapy is not delayed.
On this record, notify only patients with controlled prescriptions.
